privacy.title: Who we are
privacy.text: Sift helps restaurant operators organize supplier invoices, understand purchasing costs, and estimate recipe costs. For privacy requests, contact chimpchamp92@gmail.com. This policy covers the mobile app and its supporting services.

privacy.title: Information we process
privacy.text: We process your email address and account identifiers; restaurant name and organization identifiers; invoice photos and extracted supplier names, addresses, account numbers, line items, prices, quantities and dates; dish names, optional dish photos and recipe ingredients; subscription status and purchase identifiers; and technical crash diagnostics. Only upload documents and images you are authorized to share.

privacy.title: How we use information
privacy.text: We use this information to sign you in, separate restaurant records, extract and store invoice details, compare prices, calculate spending and recipe estimates, verify subscriptions, enforce usage limits, respond to support requests and improve reliability. We do not sell your information. Sift contains no advertising SDKs.

privacy.title: AI processing and your permission
privacy.text: With your permission, invoice images and their contents, or dish names and optional dish images, are sent to Anthropic (Claude) for invoice extraction or recipe drafting. Photos may contain personal and commercial information. Sift asks before this processing. You can decline or withdraw permission in Profile; new AI requests will stop and saved records remain available. AI results can be incorrect and should be reviewed. Provider processing and retention depend on the service terms applicable to our account; contact us for details.

privacy.title: Service providers
privacy.text: Clerk provides account authentication and organization membership. Supabase stores restaurant records and photos and runs backend functions. Anthropic processes AI requests. Apple processes App Store payments; RevenueCat verifies purchase and subscription entitlements using restaurant and transaction identifiers. Sentry receives technical diagnostics to help fix errors; Sift filters diagnostic event content to avoid sending invoice images and extracted details. The website is hosted on Vercel. Providers process data as needed to supply these services.

privacy.title: Storage and retention
privacy.text: Active restaurant records are retained to provide history and comparisons. Deleting an invoice queues its stored images for removal. Account deletion removes your authentication account and applicable personal records. Restaurants where you are the only member are deleted with their invoice and recipe data and photos; shared business records remain with remaining members. Pending deletions are retried by our backend. Minimal deletion-status records are retained for up to 30 days for retry and audit purposes. Provider backups may expire on a different schedule and are not used to restore deleted records into normal service.

privacy.title: Your choices
privacy.text: Use Profile to export invoice history as CSV, change AI processing permission, manage an Apple subscription, or delete your account. If you are the only administrator of a shared restaurant, arrange another administrator before deleting your account. Account deletion does not cancel an Apple subscription: cancel through Apple subscription settings. For access, correction, a shared-organization deletion request, or a problem completing deletion, contact chimpchamp92@gmail.com. We may need to verify your authority over the restaurant.

privacy.title: Security and international processing
privacy.text: We use authenticated access, organization-scoped database policies and private image storage. Service providers may process data outside your country. No storage or transmission method guarantees absolute security.

privacy.title: Children and changes
privacy.text: Sift is a business tool and is not directed at children under 16. We will update this policy when processing changes and request new AI permission when materially needed. Contact chimpchamp92@gmail.com with questions.

terms.title: The service
terms.text: Sift lets authorized restaurant users capture or import invoice images, review extracted records, track purchasing costs and, on paid plans, use price-change insights and recipe costing. An internet connection is required for authentication, cloud records and AI processing. You retain ownership of your uploaded content.

terms.title: Your account and restaurant
terms.text: Use a valid email address and protect your sign-in access. Only upload content you have permission to process. Restaurant records are shared with authorized organization members. The purchasing owner is responsible for managing the restaurant subscription and membership.

terms.title: Free and Pro plans
terms.text: The current Free plan includes 10 successful invoice scans per UTC calendar month. Pro includes 150 successful invoice scans and up to 25 AI recipe draft attempts per UTC calendar month, plus paid insights and recipe tools. Limits reset on the first day of the month, independently of the subscription renewal date. Failed or duplicate invoice extractions do not consume the successful-scan allowance, but reasonable attempt and request-rate limits apply to control abuse and cost. Existing legacy subscriptions retain their purchased entitlement and allowance.

terms.title: Apple subscriptions
terms.text: The App Store displays the actual localized Pro price and monthly billing period before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel through Apple subscription settings. Deleting your Sift account does not cancel a subscription. Refund requests are handled through Apple under its applicable policies. Use Restore purchases to reconnect an eligible purchase; one restaurant subscription is associated with its purchasing Apple account.

terms.title: AI and accuracy
terms.text: AI extraction and recipe drafts are estimates and can be inaccurate. Review invoice details, quantities, units and totals. Recipe costs may include clearly labeled estimates when actual invoice costs are unavailable. Supplier price changes can reflect pack-size or unit changes and are not proof of an overcharge. Sift does not guarantee savings or provide accounting, tax or professional financial advice.

terms.title: Acceptable use
terms.text: Do not upload content you have no right to share, circumvent service limits, access another restaurant’s data, interfere with the service or use it unlawfully. We may limit or suspend abusive use. Service interruptions and model-provider availability may affect new processing.

terms.title: Deletion and termination
terms.text: You can initiate account deletion in Profile. Sole-member restaurants and their data are erased; legitimate shared records remain with other members. The only administrator of a shared restaurant must arrange another administrator before leaving. See the Privacy Policy for details and contact chimpchamp92@gmail.com if you need help.

terms.title: Disclaimers and liability
terms.text: To the extent permitted by applicable law, the service is provided as available without a guarantee of uninterrupted operation or error-free results. We are not responsible for decisions made from unverified AI output. Where lawful, our aggregate liability relating to the service is limited to the amount you paid us in the preceding 12 months. Nothing in these terms limits rights or liability that cannot lawfully be limited.

terms.title: Changes and contact
terms.text: We will update these terms when necessary and provide notice of material changes where required. Questions about service or billing: chimpchamp92@gmail.com. Apple’s applicable licensed application terms also apply to the iOS app.
